en.title: Labyrinth of the Market of Yesterdays
en.premise: Stumbling into a village not found on any map, I witness an inexplicable locked-room murder and a bizarre market where memories are traded as currency. Trapped in a loop that repeats until the moment of my death, I track the clues left by my 'former selves' to corner the killer. But with every memory sold, my own identity chips away. When the truth is finally revealed, what will be left of me?

zh.title: 贩卖昨天的市场迷宫
zh.premise: 误入一座不在地图上的村庄，我目击了一场不可思议的密室杀人事件，以及一个将记忆作为货币交易的奇妙市场。在重复至死亡瞬间的循环之中，我循着“前一次的自己”留下的痕迹，步步紧逼凶手。然而，每当卖掉一段记忆，我的自我认同便随之削减。当真相大白之时，我身上还剩下什么？
